critical_code_review_comments: Data Quality Rules Engine fully implemented with 6 rule types: threshold, null_check, pattern, uniqueness, cross_reference, range
Proper validation: invalid file_type/rule_type returns 400, range requires min/max, cross_reference requires ref_file_type
Evaluate endpoint correctly handles missing files (returns 'skip' status) and evaluates active rules against uploaded data
Frontend form dynamically shows/hides fields based on rule type selection
All data-testid attributes present for testing: dq-rules-engine, rule-form, create-rule-btn, evaluate-rules-btn, rule-card-*, toggle-rule-*, edit-rule-*, delete-rule-*
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed rules during testing. Demo tenant has 3 existing rules: 'Revenue must be positive' (threshold), 'SKU must not be null' (null_check), 'Quantity in valid range' (range)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Data Quality Rules Engine fully tested and working. Backend routes at /api/quality/rules/ with CRUD + /evaluate + /toggle + /file-columns/{file_type}. Frontend component DataQualityRules.jsx renders in Custom Rules tab of Data Quality page. 6 rule types supported with dynamic form fields. Demo tenant has no uploaded data files so evaluation returns 'skip' status - this is correct behavior. B2BLeads tenant may have uploaded files for actual pass/fail results.

response.results: Array of rule evaluation results with status (pass/warn/fail/skip/error)
